corpus: P112 size32; 13 versioned chunks from three synthetic known source documents, fixed independently of this comparison
queries: 20 P112 questions reused with source-span gold; known corpus and previously seen lexical results, not blind test. Authored variants/proposals are pedagogical controls, not LLM output.

encoder.pooling: attention-mask weighted mean including active special tokens, raw float32

dense.candidates: All eligible chunk vectors; no calibrated similarity threshold, includes negative scores if necessary.

fusion.missing: No contribution; union by versioned chunk ID
fusion.ties: Descending score, then ascending codepoint chunk ID

evaluation.evidence: P112 versioned source unit coverage; all fact groups need one complete alternative; negatives null and separate

filters: Global scores/statistics fixed. Exact full rankings filtered before top-k versus after top-k. Candidate eligibility result equivalence, not native engine prefilter execution/latency; no ACL implementation.
multiQuery: Original plus two authored paraphrases for each selected case; deduplicate identical texts, BM25 each, RRF constant60/window10. No LLM inference or independent benchmark.
rewrite: Authored candidate proposals with explicit protected-token guard. Missing literal normalized tokens reject to original. One unsafe proposal deliberately preserves all protected tokens to expose the guard limitation; never treat guard as proof of semantic equivalence.
limits: Three short synthetic documents, no end-to-end generated answers or production throughput/cost claims. Preserve all outcomes; no tuning model/threshold/gold to favor a method.
